# Daily milk — full public text

> Daily milk is a free, installable web app that helps a milk delivery business
> keep its day-to-day records and turn them into reports. It is an independent
> personal project run by Rajat Malik. The app needs JavaScript and a free
> account; this file is a plain-text mirror of the core public pages for AI
> assistants and other tools that do not run JavaScript.

- App: https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/

- Last updated: 17/11/2026

The authoritative versions of the Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy and Terms of
Service are the HTML pages at

summaries; each linked page is the full article.

## About Daily milk

### Daily milk

Record-keeping software for milk delivery businesses, with full database export
and import as JSON.

Daily milk is an independent personal project run by Rajat Malik. It is not a
company, and anyone can create an account and use it. It is free, and it does not
charge you. Individual public guide articles carry Google AdSense advertising;
the app, the guides index, the about page and all policy pages do not.

### What the app does

Daily milk helps a milk delivery business keep its day-to-day records and turn
them into reports. It is used by the owner or operator of the business, on their
own device, under their own account.

- Keep a list of milkmen (suppliers and delivery staff).
- Record daily milk entries — quantity, shift and date.
- Maintain milk rates and price lists.
- Record purchases and customer payments.
- View and export reports as CSV or PDF.

### Data export and import

You can export your full database as a JSON file at any time, and import that
file on another device from the Data Management settings.

- The JSON file contains your milkmen, daily milk entries, rates, payments and
  account settings, so the app can be moved or restored without a third-party
  backup provider.
- Exports are downloaded directly to your device. They are never uploaded to a
  shared location owned by the developer.
- Importing a file overwrites the matching records in your database. Export your
  current data first if you are unsure.

### Where the rest of the data is stored

The business records themselves are stored in Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore
and Cloud Storage) under the user's own account, so they are available on every
device the user signs in from. Authentication is handled by Google Firebase
Authentication, and the app never receives the user's Google password.

### Offline and installation

Daily milk is a Progressive Web App. Screens it has already loaded keep working
without a connection, and entries made offline are kept on the device until the
connection returns. It can be installed from the browser on Android, iOS,
Windows, macOS and Linux.

### Advertising

Advertising is served by Google AdSense only on the individual guide articles
that contain substantial editorial content. It is absent from the signed-in app,
the guides index, the about page, the contact page and every policy page.
Advertising is labelled and kept separate from editorial content. Advertising
cookies are described in the cookie policy, and consent is collected through
Google's certified consent message where the law requires it, including the EEA,
the UK, Switzerland and Brazil (LGPD).

### The guides

The site publishes free, original guides on the paperwork of a milk round. They
are written for anyone running a delivery round, whether or not they use the
app. They are educational, not accounting, tax or legal advice.

### Privacy and terms

The Privacy Policy explains what information the app handles and why. The Terms
of Service set out the rules for using it. The Cookie Policy lists storage and
advertising cookies. The Disclaimer explains the limits of the guides, and the
Editorial Policy explains how they are written.

### Contact

Questions, support requests, corrections and data enquiries:
contact@rajatmalik.dev. See https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/contact.html.

## Privacy Policy

Last updated: 17/11/2026

A free personal project. I do not charge you or take payment card or billing
details. The public guides carry Google advertising; the signed-in app does not.

### 1. Who is responsible

Daily milk is an application for recording and reporting on a milk delivery
business: milkmen, daily milk entries, milk rates and payments. It is an
independent personal project run by Rajat Malik, an individual developer. It is
not a company, and there is no business entity behind it.

### 2. What is stored to run the app

**2.1 Account information.** When you create an account or sign in with Google,
the operator receives your email address, your display name and a unique account
identifier. Authentication is handled by Google Firebase Authentication. Your
Google password is never received or stored.

**2.2 Business records you enter.** Milkman details, daily milk entries, milk
rates, payments and application settings are stored in your account so they are
available on every device you sign in from. They are your data.

**2.3 Security and device information.** To help you review account activity, the
app records sign-in sessions and trusted devices, including a timestamp, the
browser's user agent string, and the IP address and approximate geographic
location reported for that connection. The approximate location is obtained by
sending the request's IP address to ipwho.is.

**2.4 Preferences.** Formatting choices such as currency and colour theme are
stored with your settings.

**2.5 Contact form.** The name, email address, optional phone number and message
you enter are used only to reply to you. They are not added to a mailing list.
The form is delivered by Web3Forms and protected by hCaptcha.

### 3. Reading the public pages

The guides, about page, contact page and policy pages are static HTML. They do
not require an account and do not set a first-party cookie. They load a local
stylesheet and, on content pages only, the Google AdSense script.

### 4. Cookies and similar technologies

The app uses browser storage for functional purposes: keeping you signed in,
remembering preferences, and storing app files and queued offline entries. That
storage is not used for advertising. Public guide pages additionally load Google
advertising, which may set cookies described in the cookie policy.

### 5. Advertising on the public guides

Advertising is served by Google AdSense only on the individual guide articles
that contain substantial editorial content. It is absent from the app, the
guides index, the about page, the contact page and all policy pages. Google's
required disclosures are:

- Third party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a
  user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
- Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads
  to users based on their visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
- Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings
  (https://www.google.com/settings/ads). Alternatively, users can opt out of a
  third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalised advertising by visiting
  https://www.aboutads.info/choices/.

Further opt-outs: https://www.youronlinechoices.eu/. Google's privacy policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy. How Google uses information from sites or
apps that use its services:
https://www.google.com/policies/technologies/partner-sites/.

Third parties may place and read cookies, web beacons, IP addresses and other
identifiers as a result of ad serving. This site does not set or modify cookies
on Google's domains, does not pass personally identifiable information to Google
for advertising, does not collect precise location for advertising, does not
offer compensation for viewing or clicking ads, and does not use interest-based
advertising to target children. The site is not directed to children.

Where the law requires consent — the EEA, the UK, Switzerland and Brazil — a
Google-certified consent message records the choice before advertising cookies
are set. This supports the GDPR, UK GDPR, LGPD and Google's EU user consent
policy. The operator does not sell personal information for money; some
advertising cookies may be treated as "sharing" or "targeted advertising" under
certain US state privacy laws, and the same controls limit that use.

### 6. How information is used

- To operate the app and display records and reports.
- To authenticate you and keep your account secure.
- To show recent account and security activity.
- To export the database as JSON, and to import it on request.
- To respond to support requests and corrections.
- To serve and measure advertising on public guides, subject to consent.
- To keep the service secure and prevent abuse.

### 7. Service providers

- **Google Firebase** (Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage) — hosts
  the account and business records.
- **Google AdSense** — serves advertising on public guide pages and may set
  advertising cookies.
- **ipwho.is** — receives the IP address of a sign-in request to return an
  approximate city, region and country for the security activity list.
- **Web3Forms** — receives contact form fields and forwards them to the
  operator's inbox.
- **hCaptcha** — checks the contact form for automated submissions.

### 8. Legal bases (EEA and UK)

Contract (operating the app), legitimate interests (security, abuse prevention,
support), consent (advertising cookies where required), and legal obligation
where applicable.

### 9. Retention and deletion

Records are kept for as long as the account exists. Deleting the account removes
the records from Daily milk. Exported files saved to a user's own device remain
under that user's control. Contact-form messages are kept only as long as needed
to deal with the enquiry.

### 10. Your rights and choices

- Export the full database to CSV, PDF or JSON at any time, and import a JSON
  export on another device.
- Request access to, correction of, or deletion of account data.
- Object to processing based on legitimate interests, or ask for restriction.
- Change or withdraw advertising consent, and opt out of personalised
  advertising at Google Ad Settings.
- Complain to a data protection authority in your country.

### 11. International transfers

The service providers are global providers and may process data outside the
user's country. Where required, transfers rely on published safeguards such as
standard contractual clauses.

### 12. Children

Daily milk is a business tool and is not directed to children. Information from
children is not knowingly collected.

### 13. Changes and contact

Material changes are reflected in the "last updated" date. Questions and data
requests: contact@rajatmalik.dev.

## Cookie Policy

Last updated: 17/11/2026

- The guides and policy pages set no first-party cookies.
- Public content pages load Google AdSense, which may set advertising cookies.
- The app stores sign-in and preference data, plus files and queued offline
  entries, in browser storage for functional purposes only.
- Google advertising cookies commonly include `__gads`, `__gpi`, `__eoi`, `IDE`
  and `test_cookie`. The exact set can change; Google's own documentation is
  authoritative.
- Control personalised advertising at https://adssettings.google.com/, via the
  Digital Advertising Alliance (https://www.aboutads.info/choices/), the European
  Interactive Digital Advertising Alliance (https://www.youronlinechoices.eu/),
  or browser cookie settings.
- Where consent is required, Google's certified consent message records the
  choice, and it can be changed later from the cookie controls on the page.

## Terms of Service

Last updated: 17/11/2026

A free personal project. You use it at your own risk, and the operator accepts no
claims for losses.

### 1. Acceptance

By creating an account, using Daily milk, or reading the guides, you agree to
these terms and to the Privacy Policy. Daily milk is an independent personal
project run by Rajat Malik. It is not a company, and these terms are not a
commercial contract with any business entity.

### 2. What the service provides

Daily milk records milk delivery business data — milkmen, daily entries, rates and
payments — and produces reports. The full database can be exported as JSON and
imported on another device. The site also publishes free educational guides,
which are informational and subject to the disclaimer. The app is a
record-keeping tool; it does not provide accounting, tax, legal or financial
advice, and figures are only as accurate as the data entered.

### 3. No charges

Daily milk is free. No payments are taken and no card, bank or billing details are
collected. The Payments screen only records amounts entered for the user's own
business; it does not move money. Public guides may display Google AdSense
advertising, which funds the site.

### 4. Your account

You are responsible for the accuracy of account information and for keeping
sign-in credentials confidential; you must be old enough to form a binding
contract; you are responsible for activity through your account and should report
suspected compromise promptly.

### 5. Acceptable use

Do not use the service unlawfully or store data you have no right to hold; do not
attempt to access another user's account or data, or probe, disrupt or overload
the service; do not send spam or abusive content through the contact page; do not
reverse engineer or resell the service except as permitted by law; do not copy
the guides wholesale and republish them.

### 6. Your data and backups

Business records belong to the user. Exported files remain under the user's
control. The operator does not claim ownership of the data. The user is
responsible for maintaining backups. Importing a backup overwrites matching
records and cannot be undone.

### 7. Third-party services and advertising

The app depends on Google Firebase, and use of that service is also governed by
Google's terms. Public guides load advertising from Google AdSense. Advertisements
are selected and served by Google, not by this site. The operator does not control
which ads appear, does not endorse the advertised products or services, and is not
a party to any transaction between a reader and an advertiser. External links are
not under the operator's control.

### 8. Availability and changes

The service is provided "as is" and "as available". Features may be added, changed
or removed, and the service may be suspended at any time. Uninterrupted or
error-free operation is not guaranteed.

### 9. Disclaimer and limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the service and the guides are provided
without warranties of any kind. The operator does not accept or honor any claim
for any loss, damage or expense arising from the app, the guides, or their use,
including lost or corrupted data, lost profits, missed or late deliveries,
billing or record-keeping errors, business interruption, and indirect or
consequential loss. Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

### 10. Intellectual property

The guides, site design and app are protected by copyright. Readers may read,
print and share links for their own use, and quote a short extract with
attribution and a link. Republishing an article in full, or using the content to
train a competing product, requires written permission.

### 11. Termination

Users may stop using the service and delete their account at any time. Access may
be suspended or terminated if these terms are breached. Provisions that by their
nature should survive — such as sections 6, 7 and 9 — continue to apply.

### 12. Changes and contact

Continued use after an update means acceptance of the revised terms. The "last
updated" date shows when they changed. Questions: contact@rajatmalik.dev.

## Disclaimer

Last updated: 17/11/2026

The guides are general educational information about record keeping for milk
delivery businesses. They are not accounting, tax, legal, financial or business
advice, and reading them creates no professional relationship. Worked examples
use round numbers and a placeholder currency; rates, tax treatment, measurement
conventions and invoicing requirements vary by place and by buyer. No outcome is
guaranteed. Statements about Daily milk describe the app at the date on the page;
the privacy policy and terms are authoritative where they apply. Advertising is
selected by Google and is not an endorsement. To the fullest extent permitted by
law, no liability is accepted for loss arising from reliance on the content.

## Editorial Policy

Last updated: 17/11/2026

The guides are written and maintained by Rajat Malik, who also builds and runs
Daily milk. Every guide has to help someone do a job: record a delivery,
calculate a bill, plan a route, or find where milk is being lost. Worked examples
are calculated and checked line by line. Local rules are not assumed. Software
claims are checked against the app and the privacy policy. Dates change when the
text changes, not when the site is rebuilt. Corrections are made and noted.

Advertising and independence: public guides may display Google AdSense
advertising. Ads are labelled and visually separated from editorial content.
Advertisers do not see articles before publication and cannot request changes.
The site does not sell sponsored posts, paid links or rankings. Where the site's
own app is mentioned, that is disclosed. Policy pages carry no advertising.
Drafting and editing tools may be used, but the operator reviews every published
sentence and is responsible for it.

## Guides index

- **How to keep daily milk delivery records** —
  https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/milk-delivery-record-keeping.html
  The seven fields every entry needs (date, shift, milkman/route, customer or
  supplier, quantity, rate, status or note), a five-minute daily routine, a
  30-minute month-end close built on four reconciliations, the three most
  expensive mistakes, and a free daily sheet.

- **How to calculate milk rates and customer bills** —
  https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/milk-rate-and-billing.html
  Per-litre and composition-based pricing, a fully worked monthly bill with a
  mid-month rate change, valuing returns, advances and partial payments,
  rounding, and reconciling the supplier's bill.

- **Planning a milk delivery route that saves time** —
  https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/route-planning.html
  Building an honest stop list, clustering before sequencing, loading the vehicle
  in reverse delivery order, planning for exceptions, and measuring whether a
  route change actually saves time.

- **Reducing milk wastage, returns and shortages** —
  https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/milk-wastage-and-returns.html
  The four kinds of loss, a one-number daily variance measure, a rolling-average
  forecasting rule with a written buffer, a returns policy template, cold-chain
  and handling basics, and a weekly ten-minute review.

- **Notebook, spreadsheet or app** —
  https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/notebook-spreadsheet-or-app.html
  An honest comparison of paper, spreadsheets and apps, the cases where paper
  wins, the three ways spreadsheets fail, backup discipline, and a five-step
  migration plan that keeps history.

- **Record keeping FAQ** —
  https://dailymilk.rajatmalik.dev/guides/faq.html
  Short answers on two shifts, mid-month rate changes, returns, fat and SNF,
  backup frequency, offline use, data storage, price, accountant exports,
  supplier mismatches, absent customers and the limits of the guides.
